Dov Benyaacov-Kurtzman I actively work to change those discriminatory policies. So yes it rubs me the wrong way when someone implies that there are "good tourists" and "bad tourists" and treats it as an undisputed fact, while it is actually contradictory to Israeli law (that does not distinguish a touristic visit of a family member from a touristic visit of non-family member).

If you agree family members of Israelis could be normal tourists and should be treated as such, then there's no argument here. Just don't align yourself so strongly with PIBA's ideology next time.
